_readme: FIAT ITEMS 29 - THE TEST (29 Oct): 8 of the full manifest's jobs (same out, seed, words), one of each new kind: gloves (a new slot, 2x2 cells - the black pair and the unique beside it), a 2x1 melee, a 5x1 gun (the wide aspect), a 1x1 pistol, a lettering risk (the door staff vest's blank back) and a dial (the pocket watch). Judged in the game before the other 171; a kept picture is skipped by the full run.
